checked: Act of May 1, 1888, ch. 213, 25 Stat. 113, opened on govinfo: agreements of December 28 and 31, 1886 (Fort Peck, Wolf Point), January 21, 1887 (Fort Belknap) and February 11, 1887 (Blackfeet Agency); Articles I to IV and VI and each agency's boundary clause; Article III amounts $165,000, $115,000 and $150,000 for ten years.

ICC Docket 279-A opinion of March 31, 1967 (OSU id 2749): 14,969,156 acres worth $11,975,324.80 on May 1, 1888, 80 cents an acre; the quote is exact; gross awards to the Blackfeet Nation, the Assiniboine and the Fort Peck Sioux.

1968 final judgments: $8,679,814.92 Blackfeet and Gros Ventre (OSU id 2486) and $1,161,354.41 Fort Peck Sioux (id 1271), each a compromise of consideration and offsets only; $3,108,506.40 to the Assiniboine (id 2004), the 1888 payments having been credited against 77 C. Cls. 347.
